reviews.text: Everyone is so friendly. It is a walk in vet office. Very quick visits!
Great place for your pets, very friendly

Dr. Burns & her staff is completely out of context and out of control. I had came in today and the vet immediately told me we were having a misunderstanding because i insulted her and her staff, and i was hanging up phones call. Never happened btw, not once had i been rude to her staff or hung up any calls, i don’t know where she got that from, she refused to give me service and asked i leave, i accepted leaving given the fact her staff and her confused me with another patient, when i corrected them her staff was completely rude to me about giving me my dog’s paperwork about his visit history. This place is completely unacceptable and the patient care is horrible. I would recommend saving your money and going to a vet that prioritizes what they’re doing and how they’re handling patient care, this staff was unacceptable and the vet’s behavior needs to be evaluated.

I have not been there in many years now . But Dr Burns is very very understanding especially with costs .yea she can be direct and rude .but maybe put yourself in her shoes. She has seen so many nightmares and animals die over people that should not ever own a animal. Also she took in many animals that were dumped ran over abused til she had to say no and stop .I didn't know she was still open . I may go see her sew if she remember us . Love her and Dr wagers in Crosby. The only vets we ever used .   She we used for our cats  and dogs but she's better with the felines lol and wagers for dogs and farm animals horses etc they both even seen my iguana and moms birds for us    i can never thank them enough
Great experience!
The best doctor—she possesses vast knowledge; she knows exactly what is wrong with your pet just by looking at them.

Worst vet I’ve ever met. I asked her for her opinion on giving my dogs a certain medicine and she went crazy saying stuff like don’t tell her how to do her job and that she knows better than I do and she wouldn’t stop saying rude things til I left. She prescribed him meds and for 2 weeks there was no improvement. But as soon as I go to another vet to get the meds I asked the rude vet about, he felt so much better and shows great improvement!

The doors, walls, counter tops, etc was completely saturated with signs saying weird things like “If you smell like marijuana (real or synthetic) do not come inside, the doctor went to the hospital due to the smell, etc” completely outlandish and inappropriate signs.

I came here during the freeze and didn’t want to drive far but trust me, you and your pets are better off going elsewhere. All she did in my case was give me the worst case scenario as if my pet wouldn’t make it and the medicine didn’t help at all, and I got yelled at for no reason. I honestly couldn’t believe the things she said and it’s hard to even do or say anything when your pet is in her hands. Yeah no help here at all, just a loss of money and respect. If you love your pets, take them elsewhere!

Dr. Burns has been our vet for 25 years. She has loved our furr babies and treated them like her own. She has guided us through some of the hardest decisions with our pets. She is kind and compassionate. We have always appreciated her quick wit and “tell it like it is“ attitude. She is truly one of a kind.

We started coming to see Doc Burns in 2009. We have taken all of our dogs here. At one time we had five rescues. We moved away in 2013 and came back today with our new puppy; after 13-16 years with our other babies. She remembered us. She’s not in it for the money; she’s in it for the love of the animals and I truly wish I could put her in my pocket and take her with us because I haven’t met another vet like her.

Highly recommended in 2009 and highly recommend in 2026.

Edit: For those who claim rudeness by the staff, perhaps look at how you treat your animals.

Dr. Burn is an excellent veterinarian very straightforward personality & straight to the point. She will not lie just like many veterinarians do just to obtain your business.  If you are a serious person about your pet's health then she is the correct vet for you just know her personality is not for everyone.
Havent been there in years but took a new pet everyone was very nice.
I took my injured kitten in and they treated him with great professionalism and care.
The staff were all sweet and professional! Amazing veterinarian, I brought my Pekingese in and she saved him and caught onto a illness he had that I wasn't aware of. Forever Grateful! 💖

Dr. Burns is HORRIBLE. Was extremely rude when she realized we were working on a budget. I’m not asking you to care for my pet for free, but I don’t need you to be passive aggressive when we are at a time of crisis. Will not be returning. Being a decent human being isn’t difficult.
Dr.Burns is a wonderful vet! She truly cares about your pets and is very knowledgeable. I highly recommend! She saved my kitty 🐈 …
She is a great vet  very knowledgeable and gets to the point
Dr. Burns is knowledgeable and her staff is very caring!
Affordable place, awesome staff. Very knowledgeable and fast service.

DO NOT GO HERE Extremely unprofessional vets here and horrible service , they don’t know how to speak to their clients in a professional way
this one lady vet in particular is extremely rude and i honestly hope she gets fired for her behavior. DO NOT GO HERE they do not care about your pets !!!!! they only want your money !!!!!!!!
I always go there with my dog and cat. Price is not expensive at other places

I'm so grateful to the doctor and her assistant, a very kind and friendly girl. The doctor is an excellent human being—concise, detail-oriented, and very informative. Thank you! My dog ​​is happy, and so am I, of course. Many thanks to this clinic and everyone who works here in every way! ✌️🙌🙏🏻🤗✅ …
